tasks.DefineVariables: Define the variables M (number of men) and D (total amount for gift).
tasks.InitialContribution: Calculate initial contribution per man as D/M.
tasks.NewContribution: Calculate new contribution per remaining man as NewTotalAmount / (M - 3) = D/(M-3).
tasks.NewTotalAmount: Recalculate total amount to be contributed after 3 men drop out, which is now D/(M-3).
